title: Fix race condition in concurrent user registration
body:
Fix race condition in concurrent user registration
We've discovered a race condition in the user registration process that allows duplicate users to be created when multiple registration requests are processed simultaneously with the same email address.
The issue occurs when:
1. Two registration requests with the same email arrive nearly simultaneously
2. Both requests pass the email uniqueness check before either is committed
3. Both users get created, violating the unique email constraint
4. This causes data inconsistency and authentication issues
Current symptoms:
- Intermittent duplicate key errors in the database
- Users unable to login after registration
- Data integrity violations in the users table
Required fixes:
- Implement proper locking mechanism for email uniqueness checks
- Add database constraints to prevent duplicates
- Implement idempotent registration endpoints
- Add proper error handling for constraint violations
- Write comprehensive tests for concurrent scenarios
The registration code is in /src/auth/registration.py and uses PostgreSQL as the database. Consider using database-level locks or application-level distributed locks.

title: Fix race condition in inventory management system
body:
Fix race condition in inventory management system
The inventory management system has a critical race condition that allows overselling of products when multiple customers purchase the same item simultaneously. This results in negative inventory levels and fulfillment issues.
Race condition scenario:
1. Multiple users add the same low-stock item to cart simultaneously
2. All users proceed to checkout at the same time
3. Inventory checks pass for all users (before any inventory is decremented)
4. All orders are processed successfully
5. Inventory goes negative, causing fulfillment problems
Current issues:
- Overselling of limited inventory items
- Negative stock levels in database
- Customer complaints about canceled orders
- Manual intervention required to fix inventory discrepancies
- Lost sales due to inventory inaccuracies
Required fixes:
1. Implement atomic inventory operations with proper locking
2. Add inventory reservation system during checkout process
3. Implement optimistic concurrency control with version numbers
4. Add inventory validation at multiple checkout stages
5. Create inventory reconciliation processes
6. Add real-time inventory monitoring and alerts
7. Implement automatic inventory correction mechanisms
The inventory system is in /src/inventory/ and uses PostgreSQL. Consider using database-level constraints and transactions to prevent race conditions.
